envelope.description: Implement the inbound half of the comment sync

body.title: Implement the inbound half of the comment sync
body.summary: Add src/workflow/tracker/comment-sync.ts with syncUnitComments' inbound half: find the unit's artifact and issue from its binding (the LLD for a Story, the TASK head for a Task), read the issue's comments in full, drop the framework's comments, and record each human comment once through FeedbackService.add with its entry id, actor, kind and source; failures go in the result and nothing throws.
acceptanceChecks: A human comment is recorded once as feedback by the tracker user with its kind and source, and a repeated sync records nothing
Framework comments are counted as skipped and never recorded
A comment edited on the tracker after it was recorded is skipped silently and does not fail later syncs
A failed read or a failed record is in the result's failed list, the call can be repeated, and a comment that failed to record is picked up on the next sync
A unit with no binding or no artifact returns a result that says so

tests.name: comment-sync-inbound.test.ts: a human comment is recorded once as feedback with the tracker user as author, framework comments are never recorded, an edited comment is not mirrored, and a tracker failure is reported without failing the call
